findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Lambda configuration or Terraform state.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, leaving sensitive data protected only by default AWS-managed keys or not encrypted with customer-controlled keys.
